target.statement: InstructSeg achieves 85.8 cIoU on refCOCO val (RES), the headline image-level referring segmentation result.

compute.basis: Training requires 80k iterations with batch size 32 on 8×A100 GPUs (paper implementation details); even a single A100 run would take many hours, and CPU-only training is infeasible.

blockers: No code or model weights released (paper says code will be made publicly available in the near future)
Training requires 8×A100 GPUs (80 GB VRAM each) for 80k iterations
Multi-dataset training (RefCOCO/+/g, ReasonSeg, Ref-YouTube-VOS, ReVOS, LLaVA-150k) needed to reproduce the joint-training result
Large disk and RAM requirements for datasets and model checkpoints
title: InstructSeg: Unifying Instructed Visual Segmentation with Multi-modal Large Language Models
